title: Lo, God to Heav'n Ascendeth
description: Lo, God to Heav'n Ascendeth in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Gottfried Wilhelm Sacer, first published in 1661. The English translation is by Frances Elizabeth Cox (1841). The tune, VON GOTT WILL ICH NICHT LAZEN, is by Johann Crüger (1640). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Lo, God to Heav'n as-cen-deth! Through-out its re-gions vast With shouts tri-um-phant blend-eth the trum-pet's thrill-ing blast: Sing praise to Christ the Lord; sing praise with ex-ul-ta-tion, King of each hea-then na-tion, the God of Hosts a-dored!

lines: Sing praise to Christ the Lord;
the Lord who set them free.
No more the way is hidden,
The road to Heav'n that goes.
yet here He will not leave us,
And soon in Heav'n receive us
to Heav'n we, too, shall rise,
There may each heart be found!
There let our Hope be centered;
our Life, and Way to Heaven,
To whom all pow'r is given,
our Joy and Hope and Crown."
